name: Distant Sunlight, Endless Regrets
source:
Sun is a failure of an angel, exiled from heaven for their sins. As they aimlessly wander the world, they meet Laura - a lonely girl who is very excited to pick up this stray angel she found, and seems to accept them as they are. Can Sun free themselves from their past and find happiness with her? 

[From [url=https://frgmnt.itch.io/distant-sunlight-endless-regrets]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
太阳是一位失败的天使，因罪孽而被逐出天堂。当他们漫无目的地漫游世界时，他们遇到了劳拉——一个孤独的女孩，她非常兴奋地捡起了她发现的这个流浪天使，并且似乎接受了他们本来的样子。Sun能否摆脱过去并与她一起找到幸福呢？

[来自[url=https://frgmnt.itch.io/distant-sunlight-endless-regrets]itch.io[/url]]
